name: Resource FYI

sources.title: Homepage — curated directory of tools/resources for devs, designers, marketers; 'submit products or tools for free to get listed'; active 'Latest Resources' feed shows frequent new approvals
Submit page — gates behind social login: 'Sign in with Google / Sign in with Github… social login is here to fight spam'

conditions: Submission is free but requires signing in with a Google or GitHub social account — there is no email-signup or anonymous path
Listings go through an approval step ('Recently submitted & approved' phrasing on the latest feed)
requirements: Google or GitHub account for social login (anti-spam gate; site pledges not to post to your profile)
Product must fit one of the site's categories (AI, developer tools, design tools, no-code, productivity, marketing, web dev, etc.)
Editorial approval before the listing appears publicly
preparation: A Google or GitHub account you're willing to OAuth
The best-fit category from their list
workflow: Sign in with Google or GitHub
Fill the submit form (resource name, URL, description, category, thumbnail)
Wait for approval — approved items appear in the 'Latest Resources' feed and their category page
watchFor: Social-login gate is mandatory — an OAuth consent screen will appear; use an account appropriate for a public maker profile
Ads are present on pages; don't confuse ad slots for site content
The batch's 'nofollow' link hint is plausible but unverified — check the live listing's rel attribute if link type matters
Free-tier visibility is a standard listing; 'Featured' slots on the homepage are likely promotional
countsAsLive: The resource appears publicly in 'Latest Resources' or its category page on resource.fyi with a 'Visit Site' link
unknowns: Approval turnaround time and rejection criteria
Whether listing links are dofollow or nofollow
